name: SonnetDB
description: 接入 SonnetDB 5.0 九模型43工具；按 tools/list 发现，默认 Read，已授权写入还需目标库 Write grant。运维须另行授权。
description_zh: 接入 SonnetDB 5.0 九模型43工具；按 tools/list 发现，默认 Read，已授权写入还需目标库 Write grant。运维须另行授权。
description_en: Discover 43 SonnetDB 5.0 tools for nine models. Default to Read; writes require explicit user authorization and a database Write grant. Operations require separate authorization.
examples_zh: 列出这个 SonnetDB 数据库里的 measurement，并说明每个 schema。
查询过去 24 小时每台设备的温度均值，结果最多返回 100 行。
在我已授权且具备目标库 Write grant 时，写入指定 KV 并回读；query_sql 仍只读。
帮我制定 SonnetDB 的部署、备份和升级检查清单。
examples_en: List the measurements in this SonnetDB database and describe their schemas.
Query the average temperature per device for the last 24 hours, returning at most 100 rows.
After my explicit authorization and a database Write grant, write the specified KV value and verify it by reading it back.
Create a SonnetDB deployment, backup, and upgrade checklist.
